purpose: Metadata-only registry of constitutional structure comparators and existing embedding datasets. Locally cached text samples are excluded from version control under .aurelius/comparisons/.
source_policy: Do not redistribute cached legal texts or third-party datasets based on this registry. Verify source version and rights before processing or publishing.

constitutional_texts.title: Basic Law for the Federal Republic of Germany
constitutional_texts.source_authority: Federal Ministry of Justice / Federal Office of Justice; translation in cooperation with German Bundestag Language Service
constitutional_texts.version_note: English translation includes amendments through 2025-03-22; source warns German text may be more current.
constitutional_texts.structure: Preamble and article-structured HTML; rights section includes application, limits and remedies; amendment provision Article 79.
constitutional_texts.rights_note: Official translation; terms for use are linked from the source's Translations notice and were not independently confirmed for redistribution. Local inspection copy only.

constitutional_texts.title: Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, Chapter 1: Founding Provisions
constitutional_texts.source_authority: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
constitutional_texts.version_note: Source page states text as at 2026-05-07; consult the Department's chapter index for other sections. A separate full-text translation/PDF page notes image-PDF format for its downloads.
constitutional_texts.structure: Readable HTML with numbered sections and subsections; part of a chapter-organized constitution.
constitutional_texts.rights_note: Source page carries Department of Justice copyright notice. Local inspection copy only; no reuse/redistribution permission inferred.

constitutional_texts.title: The Constitution of India
constitutional_texts.language: English/Kannada diglot edition; the English text is article structured
constitutional_texts.source_authority: Government of India, Ministry of Law and Justice, Legislative Department; the edition preface says the text was vetted by the Official Languages Wing and updated through the 106th Amendment.
constitutional_texts.structure: Parts and numbered articles, including Part III fundamental rights, Part IVA fundamental duties, and Part XX amendment procedure.
constitutional_texts.rights_note: Official government edition; PDF shows Government of India copyright. No redistribution or open license reviewed.

embedding_datasets.title: Standard Works — Contextual Retrieval Embeddings
embedding_datasets.corpus: Bible Old and New Testaments, Book of Mormon, Doctrine and Covenants, Pearl of Great Price
embedding_datasets.chunking: Verse rows embed contextual_text: generated chapter summary/context plus verse; not bare verse text.
embedding_datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 for chapter summaries, embeddings and dataset arrangement; source card describes verse editions as public domain.
embedding_datasets.compatibility: same published model and full dimension; input construction differs from bare canonical passages
embedding_datasets.artifact_status: downloadable Hugging Face dataset; not downloaded into this repository
embedding_datasets.verification_note: Published card gives model, width, granularity, context recipe and license. Exact OpenAI API request/version metadata was not independently verified.

embedding_datasets.title: Quran Embeddings Dataset
embedding_datasets.corpus: Quran, 6236 ayah rows with Arabic and English text fields
embedding_datasets.model: OpenAI embedding model (exact model identifier unknown)
embedding_datasets.chunking: One vector per ayah per dataset card; exact input construction unknown.
embedding_datasets.license: Unresolved: dataset card declares MIT; README restricts use to research, education and non-commercial purposes.
embedding_datasets.compatibility: not compatible with full 3072-dimensional text-embedding-3-large configuration; model/provenance and license conflict need resolution
embedding_datasets.artifact_status: public Hugging Face dataset; not downloaded into this repository
embedding_datasets.verification_note: Embedding sequence width is shown as 1536. README says OpenAI without naming the model.

embedding_datasets.title: US & Iowa Legal Embeddings (RAG-Optimized)
embedding_datasets.corpus: Includes US Constitution (129 chunks) and Iowa Constitution (288 chunks), plus other US/Iowa law
embedding_datasets.chunking: Chunk-level; Iowa law segmented with Gemini 2.0 Flash; other collections use structure-aware headings/sections/boundaries.
embedding_datasets.license: Hugging Face card labels license other; README says source materials are government publications and most content public domain. Exact dataset reuse terms unknown.
embedding_datasets.compatibility: not compatible: different embedding model; equal dimensionality would not make vectors comparable
embedding_datasets.artifact_status: public Hugging Face dataset; large Chroma artifact, not downloaded into this repository
embedding_datasets.verification_note: The dataset includes constitution corpora, but is not a model-space match for OpenAI text-embedding-3-large.

embedding_datasets.title: Clarus sacred-text RAG project
embedding_datasets.corpus: README reports Quran and Bible collections across English and Turkish editions
embedding_datasets.chunking: Semantic grouping of verses that preserves scripture boundaries (README claim).
embedding_datasets.license: Code MIT; upstream text/data rights remain distinct and are not comprehensively established by code license.
embedding_datasets.compatibility: same published model and full dimensions claimed; not cleared because a distributable vector artifact and per-vector input provenance were not verified
embedding_datasets.artifact_status: project describes a Qdrant runtime index; reusable downloadable vector artifact not verified
embedding_datasets.verification_note: Research lead only; do not treat README model statement as sufficient provenance for imported vectors.

comparison_caveat: Do not compare vectors from different embedding models. Matching model name and width are necessary but not sufficient: preserve model/version/configuration, input construction, chunk boundaries, preprocessing, and source/license provenance.
